title.rendered: ntop Summer Tour: Interop Japan, Italy, Greece, Norway, Croatia…

content.rendered:
This summer we are touring to present all the latest development and enhancements to our tool suite. In particular we will be focusing on:

  • High-definition visibility.
  • Post-quantum traffic analysis.
  • Monitoring large networks.
  • Artificial Intelligence in network observability.

For those who cannot meet us in person can follow us in webinars, but we definitively prefer to see you in person. Below you can see some of our 2026 summer tour dates and places:

  • ITNOG 2026, Bologna, Italy, April 21st.
  • GARR 26, Pisa, Italy, May 19-21st.
  • Neacademy, Napoli, Italy, June 3rd.
  • Interop 26 Tokyo, Japan, June 10-12th.
    We will be present at the Jupiter Technology booth (J3-07), and
    give a 1 hour seminar on June 12th at 15:10 on Classroom J, Hall 7.
  • GRNOG 20, Athens. Greece, June 30th.
  • NONOG-8 / NIX-2026, Oslo, Norway, September 9th.
  • NOG.HR 7, Zagreb, Croatia, September 10th.

We would like to meet our community in person so we invite you to show up. We are planning to attend other events after the summer, so stay tuned for updates.

See you !
